senses.gloss: f. (לָבַשׁ) putting on, dressing, opp. פשיטה undressing.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 32a:9">Yoma 32ᵃ</cite> <he>מה ל׳ טעון וכ׳</he> as well as dressing (the priest’s putting on his priestly garments) requires sanctification (washing), so does &c.; Y. ib. III, 40ᶜ <he>מה ל׳ מקדש וכ׳</he> as well as he must sanctify himself for dressing &c.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:10">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> <he>לְבִישַׁת כלאים התרתי וכ׳</he> (I forbade thee) to wear clothes of mixed material, as an offset I permitted thee &c.
